description: Every dated public call The White Report has made, its grade date, and its grade (null while pending). Start here for the track record in human-readable form; use calls_list instead for the sealed machine-format envelopes (wr.calls.v1) behind the same calls. Takes no parameters. Returns the scoreboard exactly as published in the site's calls file — the same record the website shows, with grade null on calls still pending grading. Behaviour: read-only and public — no authentication or API key; every call is logged in aggregate (tool name, result count, coarse client class; no IP addresses).
name: get_scoreboard
title: Get Scoreboard
